import pandas as pd
from helpers.cleaning import parse_currency_amount, clean_status

orders = pd.read_csv('data/orders.csv', keep_default_na=False)
refunds = pd.read_csv('data/refunds.csv', keep_default_na=False)

orders['amount'] = orders['amount'].apply(parse_currency_amount)
orders['status'] = orders['status'].apply(clean_status)
refunds['refund_amount'] = refunds['refund_amount'].apply(parse_currency_amount)

completed_orders = orders[orders['status'] == 'COMPLETED'].copy()
total_revenue = completed_orders['amount'].sum()
total_refunds = refunds[refunds['order_id'].isin(completed_orders['order_id'])]['refund_amount'].sum()

print(float(total_revenue - total_refunds))
